post-install-output: * <fg=blue>Tool Guard</>: put <comment>#[Granted]</>, <comment>#[Limit]</>, <comment>#[RateLimit]</> or <comment>#[RequiresApproval]</> on your AI tools.
* <comment>php bin/console debug:tool-guard</> lists every tool an AI can call and its rules.
* Held calls wait at <comment>/admin/ai/approvals</> (ROLE_ADMIN): keep it behind your firewall,

contents: # Tool Guard: rules in code for the tools an AI agent can call (Symfony AI agent tools and MCP tools).
approver_role: ROLE_ADMIN       # who may approve or reject a held call
mode: enforce                   # observe: nothing is blocked, the journal records what would have been
expire_after: 86400             # seconds a held call may wait before it can no longer be approved
four_eyes: false                # true: nobody approves a call made for themselves
# notifier:                     # tell the approvers through your framework.notifier channels
# The approvals page for held calls. It checks tool_guard.approver_role itself; keep it behind
# your firewall so that visitors are asked to sign in.
